name: ESM3
one_liner: Multimodal masked generative model over protein sequence, 3D structure, and function, aligned with geometric and wet-lab fluorescence feedback.

loop.proposes: A 98B multimodal protein model iteratively unmasks sequence, 3D backbone coordinates, and catalytic/functional tokens.
loop.judged_by: All-atom geometric consistency metrics (TM-score, active-site RMSD), preference alignment rewards, and wet-lab chromophore fluorescence assays judge candidates.
loop.steers: Chain-of-thought structural decoding and direct preference alignment on verified structures steer generation toward folded functional proteins.

headline_result: Generated esmGFP, a glowing fluorescent protein sharing only 58% sequence identity with the closest known fluorescent protein (~500 million years of evolutionary divergence).
caveat: Wet-lab expression success rates vary strongly by target protein fold and cellular host environment.
beyond_harness_note: 3D geometric consistency verifiers and wet-lab functional assays filter and align a multimodal protein generator.
algorithmic_authority: 3D structural consistency verifier and wet-lab fluorescence assay

sources.title: Simulating 500 million years of evolution with a language model (Science, 2025)

verification.notes: Checked against Hayes et al., Science 387, 2025. Year corrected 2024 to 2025 (Science published 2025-02-21; 2024 was the preprint) per the corpus citation ledger.
